svg.title: About Himesh
svg.desc: Database to pixel. I'm a full stack engineer from Sri Lanka. I work across the whole product — React and Next.js on the web, React Native on mobile, Node, Laravel and Postgres underneath — and I care about making it useful, maintainable and fast. Lately: what AI changes about how we build. End-to-end engineering: Frontend, backend, APIs, data, mobile. Product thinking: The real problem, not just the ticket. Architecture & ownership: Planning, reviews, releases.
